balanced.title: Advertising
balanced.summary: Known advertising delivery and auction hosts across apps.
balanced.caveat: Recommended balance. Hostname blocking cannot remove page layout gaps, same-origin ads, or overlays drawn by a browser or app.

aggressive.title: Advertising — Aggressive
aggressive.summary: Broader advertising hostname coverage for users who accept a higher risk of broken content.
aggressive.caveat: Opt-in and higher breakage risk. This tier replaces Advertising; it does not stack with it.
